input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

step.description: Which part of the pipeline to run.
step.help_text: `prepare_inputs` downloads the genomes, host baits and viral database and writes the samplesheet for `screening`; `screening` runs every `eefinder screening` stage on each genome and clusters its elements; `analysis` builds the genome phylogeny and the plots from a finished screening (`--screening_outdir`).

input.description: Path to the samplesheet: genome accessions for `--step prepare_inputs`, genomes and references for `--step screening` and `--step analysis`.
input.help_text: `--step prepare_inputs`: columns `accession` and optional `virus_taxid`. `--step screening`: columns `sample,taxid,genome,baits,db_fasta,db_metadata` (written by `--step prepare_inputs`). See the [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/evefinder/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

genome_source.description: Where to download the genomes from.
genome_source.help_text: `ncbi` uses the NCBI Datasets API (GCA_/GCF_, FASTA + GFF3 when annotated); `ena` uses the ENA browser API (GCA_ only, FASTA only).

download_virus_db.description: Download the viral protein database with `eefinder get-databases virus`.
download_virus_db.help_text: One database per distinct `virus_taxid` in the samplesheet; rows without one (or no such column) use eefinder's default taxon (10239, Viruses).

virus_db_release_date.description: Only include viral data released on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

virus_db_fasta.description: Local viral protein database FASTA, used instead of downloading one.

search_mode.description: Similarity search: BLAST (`blastx`) or a DIAMOND sensitivity (eefinder `-md`).

translation_method.description: How proteins are obtained for the searches (eefinder `-tm`).

range_junction.description: Range for joining redundant hits in `align`/`filter` (`-rj`).

merge_limit.description: Distance in bases for bedtools merge in `merge` (`-lm`).

merge_level.description: Taxonomy level used to merge elements (`-ml`).

mask_per.description: Percentage of lowercase bases above which an element is considered repetitive (`-mp`).

overlap.description: What to do with overlapping elements (`-ov`).

target_families.description: Comma-separated families to KEEP with `--overlap targets` (`-tf`).

non_target_families.description: Comma-separated families to DROP with `--overlap targets` (`-ntf`).

flank.description: Length of the flanking regions extracted around each element (`-fl`).

removetmp.description: Do not publish the intermediate files to `tmp_files/` (`-rm`).

skip_clustering.description: Do not cluster the elements of each genome (cd-hit-est).

cluster_tool.help_text: `cdhit` (cd-hit-est, greedy from the longest element) or `vclust` (prefilter, align and cluster with `--algorithm cd-hit`; identity is the ANI of the aligned regions). Both write the same table.

cluster_identity.description: Minimum identity of an element to its cluster representative (cd-hit-est `-c`, 0.8 at least; vclust `--ani`).

cluster_coverage.description: Minimum alignment coverage of both the element and its representative (cd-hit-est `-aS`/`-aL`, vclust `--qcov`/`--rcov`).

get_databases_options.title: Get-databases options
get_databases_options.description: `eefinder get-databases host`/`virus` options, used by `--step prepare_inputs`.

getdb_stall_timeout.description: Seconds without progress before a download is retried; 0 waits forever (`--stall-timeout`).

getdb_keep_download.description: Keep the downloaded zip and extracted ncbi_dataset directory (`--keep-download`).

host_refseq.description: Host baits: RefSeq only; false fetches all sequences (`--refseq/--all-sequences`).

host_cluster.description: Host baits: collapse 100%-identical proteins with cd-hit (`--cluster/--no-cluster`).

host_exclude_taxon.description: Host baits: comma-separated taxa to leave out (`--exclude-taxon`).

host_max_rank.description: Host baits: a host with no annotated assembly gets the proteins of its closest annotated relative (species, genus, family...), searched up to this rank.

virus_db_refseq.description: Viral database: RefSeq only; false fetches all sequences (`--refseq/--all-sequences`).

virus_db_cluster.description: Viral database: collapse 100%-identical proteins with cd-hit (`--cluster/--no-cluster`).

virus_db_exclude_taxon.description: Viral database: comma-separated taxa to leave out (`--exclude-taxon`). Default: eefinder's (2697049, SARS-CoV-2); 'none' disables it.

virus_db_split_level.description: Viral database: one request per taxon at this rank (`--split-level`).

virus_db_include_unranked.description: Viral database: also download subtrees with no taxon at the split level (`--include-unranked`).

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: Options for `--step analysis`, run on the results of `--step screening`.

screening_outdir.description: The `--outdir` of the `--step screening` run to analyse.
screening_outdir.help_text: `--step analysis` reads `<screening_outdir>/screening/<sample>/<sample>.EEs.{fa,tax.tsv}` for every sample of `--input`. A sample without them must be listed in `screening/skipped_genomes.tsv`.

skip_phylogeny.description: Do not build the genome phylogeny.

swarm_top_proteins.description: Proteins coloured in each genome's swarm plot; the others are grey (`Other`).
